11798|a2b097f2.name: Bunthen Plainswind
11798|a2b097f2.text: Would you like a flight to Thunder Bluff, courtesy of the Cenarion Circle?

11802|ef8483c2.name: Dendrite Starblaze
11802|ef8483c2.text:
Greetings, $c.  You are welcome in Nighthaven, as well as all of Moonglade.  The Cenarion Circle welcomes all beings who respect the authority and command of nature.

While you are here, please be sure to preserve the balance in all things.  Disturbances are not welcome here, and our wardens are trained to cease all hostilities without question.

11833|eb2e4319.name: Rahauro
11833|eb2e4319.text:
Well met, $c. You may speak to me unless you have direct business with my mistress Magatha.

I deal with most of her tasks for her so she can concentrate on more important matters. Perhaps there are some things we could discuss before you seek audience with her?

14728|9fb0176c.name: Rumstag Proudstrider
14728|9fb0176c.text:
Hail sister... I'd like a moment of your time, if I may.

We tauren have endured much in our trials and tribulations in establishing our homeland.  We now find ourselves in a dire shortage of cloth.  If you have the materials to spare, I ask that you please donate them.  You certainly would earn the gratitude of tauren everywhere in helping us out!

251968|88447c8b.name: Ayessa Dawnsinger
251968|88447c8b.text: Greetings, I am Ayessa Dawnsinger, the current Grand Skyseer of the Windshapers. What may I do for you?

251992|f5ff5fa7.name: Fenn Fairweather
251992|f5ff5fa7.text: Welcome to Shen'dar Village, some of the best fishing this side of the mountain range. If you are looking to catch fish, I can teach you, for a price.

252359|80b579b6.name: Lotheluum Starbreeze
252359|80b579b6.text: Our kind are rare these days, but there are those who still dream in emerald amongst the Shen'dorei.

254151|20a1483e.name: Vayn Moongaze
254151|20a1483e.text:
You've earned a degree of trust amongst the Nightclaw, $c. We don't have much to offer you as a reward, but we have managed to scavenge a number of crafting plans from the ruins of Ban'aethal.

The magesmiths of Ban'aethal were widely regarded to be the best artisans in all of the $R Isles. The Nightclaw are naturalists, not crafters, so these records are of little use to us.

Continue to prove yourself to be a valuable ally, and I would make these secrets available to you.

255940|9cc50b7d.name: Donaal Downbreeze
255940|9cc50b7d.text: Welcome to the Calmbreeze Inn, traveler. Would you like some refreshment?

256388|13e9970d.name: Jornah
256388|13e9970d.text:
Greetings and well met, $N! Your arrival is timely, and we here at the Durotar Supply and Logistics company are always in need of new contractors.

If you are someone with a knack for gathering useful materials or the skills to craft something from scratch, you have a place here.

Please let me know if you have any questions.

256388|1ae640d8.name: Jornah
256388|1ae640d8.text:
I am glad you asked! We are far more than just a delivery service, $N. We employ and contract craftsmen across a variety of specialties and trades, and keep our ear to the ground for any new opportunities to keep their hands busy and goods flowing. We cannot possibly predict the emergent needs of any potential client, so we depend on their crafting orders to arrive to us.

You can imagine that this pipeline is... not as effective as we would hope. We encourage any crafters to satisfy these demands and deliver the goods directly to the customers, wherever they may be. Worry not, you will be fairly compensated for your troubles and earn respect among our organization.

256388|631ab615.name: Jornah
256388|631ab615.text:
Recently there has been a sharp rise in lost orders. We strive to ensure that each delivery is efficient and safe, but with a rise of bandits, rowdy creatures, and those damned Alliance, inevitably not every delivery goes according to plan.

Should you find these shipments, take a look over the label for what it should contain. It is not your responsibility to deal with our mistakes, but if you complete the shipment, you will be rewarded in kind. 

Dokimi over by the wagon can handle the logistics and your compensation. We will take it from there.

256388|6df3de7b.name: Jornah
256388|6df3de7b.text:
Yes! Well. Sort of.

Gold is the true universal currency, but we have our own system for trade amongst ourselves known as Merchant's Favor. It abstracts away the ever-fluctuating value of gold and silver, and ensures fair and equitable trade between members of the organization. It cannot be liquidated to gold, unless you're engaging in some shady activity, I suppose.

We still use gold for typical day-to-day needs such as materials needed for common crafts, but otherwise rely on Merchant's Favor for any kind of internal commerce.

If you assist us with recovering waylaid crates and ensuring swift fulfillment of craftsman's writs, you will earn plenty!

257008|2d37e4b8.name: Baelann Swiftcurrent
257008|2d37e4b8.text: Me, o ealdor Veldbarad. Bor nud faergas me thor se o daegil aldonoth? Majis Y gol nuff nud o algos se ash?

257036|a6bb08a8.name: Baelann Favorbreeze
257036|a6bb08a8.text: Welcome to the Bank of Valanaar. We can secure your belongings and valuables here should you so desire. Do you wish to access your deposit box?

259118|b3bb7fbb.name: Muln Earthfury
259118|b3bb7fbb.text: I am Muln Earthfury of the Earthen Ring. What brings you before me today?

262560|d1e27715.name: Hana Lighthoof
262560|d1e27715.text: $N, how may I further your training in the eyes of the Earth Mother?

264078|adb68b1b.name: Sutara Plainstalker
264078|adb68b1b.text:
It is my honor to handle supply and provisioning for the Earthen Ring. 

My stock is limited at present, but check back with me often and I may have new equipment and supplies available for purchase.

276171|1e85fa3a.name: Oura Stormspinner
276171|1e85fa3a.text: We shen'dorei have need of additional cloth to replenish our supplies. Any donations you make would be put to good use, and surely raise your esteem with the Windshapers.

2995|bfaf54b7.name: Tal
2995|bfaf54b7.text: When mounted on the back of a wind rider, one sees that its reputation for strength and speed is well earned.

3033|febb65fa.name: Turak Runetotem
3033|febb65fa.text:
Welcome, my sister.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to teach you.

It never hurts to reaffirm one's place within what I like to call the Great Balance.  As preservers of this balance, we must strive to continually keep our minds clear and our hearts strong.  Training helps us in this regard.

3050|57562eaa.name: Veren Tallstrider
3050|57562eaa.text: The tauren are sons and daughters of the Earthmother, and we show respect to all her children.  Even the beasts we slay are cherished, as their bodies give nourishment and their skins provide warmth.

3390|eb12150e.name: Apothecary Helbrim
3390|eb12150e.text: The Barrens holds a wealth of substances for which we, the apothecaries or Lordaeron, may find use.

3429|4e7d06f7.name: Thork
3429|4e7d06f7.text:
Welcome to the Crossroads, $c. My name is Thork--I lead the defenses here in the name of the Warchief.

Please, feel free to make yourself at home. As long as you mind your business, no one should have any problem with you taking up some space.

There are many threats to our safety here. If you've already become familiar with the lay of the land, speak to the others here--perhaps they have tasks for you to do.

3432|c1a3099b.name: Mankrik
3432|c1a3099b.text:
I came to the Crossroads from the south seeking help, $c, but I find only cowards who turn their backs on me--even the mighty Thork insults me so. He is a good leader, but his dismissal of my plea causes me greater anger.

He claims my rage makes me hasty--that it clouds my judgement--but I will not rest until I have vengeance!

3448|dcea3712.name: Tonga Runetotem
3448|dcea3712.text: The times we live in are as fickle as the shifting winds, $c.  It is important to remember what is true and lasting in this world, and to preserve that.  Everything else is a waste.

3453|48c11c0f.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
3453|48c11c0f.text: Something I can help you with, $N? There's a shipment I've got to see to otherwise.

3615|ddd7878b.name: Devrak
3615|ddd7878b.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

4184|dd12f193.name: Geenia Sunshadow
4184|dd12f193.text:
Ishnu-alah, traveler, and welcome to Nighthaven.

Would you like to browse my selection of fine dresses?

5769|c9ae2675.name: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem
5769|c9ae2675.text: The earth keeps many secrets, $c; it is our duty to ensure that those that must remain a secret for the good of all stays as such.

6791|60c5da07.name: Innkeeper Wiley
6791|60c5da07.text: Come in, come in. Just don't sit too close to the stove. It hasn't exploded yet today, but just to be safe I think you should sit elsewhere.

6126-accept.name: Hana Lighthoof
6126-accept.text:
You're now ready to learn about poison and the power we as druids have over it, $N.  Cenarius has blessed us with the ability to purge even the most foul of poisons with but a mere incantation.  This gift is not to be taken lightly... and to ensure you learn this lesson, you'll work to address the effects of poisonings as a layman would.

Travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze; he awaits your arrival to begin your lesson.
6126-accept.title: Lessons Anew

7820-progress.name: Rumstag Proudstrider
7820-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by Thunder Bluff for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7820-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

93459-complete.name: Vayn Moongaze
93459-complete.text: As promised, here is your reward.
93459-complete.title: More Al'Aketh Ears

96339-complete.name: Innkeeper Wiley
96339-complete.text:
Wait, wait, you said your name was $N?

$N! I am so glad to finally meet you. Someone delivered a package here addressed to you and assured me that you would eventually come to pick it up. I tried to tell them that we don't do that around here, but before I could get a word in, they were already gone!

Your timing is great, too. It was gonna be lumped up with all the other garbage that I toss into the sea nightly.

What? We all do it. Ugh, just take your package and go!
96339-complete.title: Legacy Reward: Replica Ironforge Air Rifle

97967-complete.name: Fenn Fairweather
97967-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Fish Bowl. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97967-complete.title: Camping 101: Fishing

99196-progress.name: Oura Stormspinner
99196-progress.text:
The Windshapers are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.

A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the Windshapers for your generosity. 

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
99196-progress.title: A Donation of Wool
